company.name: Sublime Security
company.shortDescription: Sublime Security develops an email security platform to write and run custom detection and response rules to block phishing attacks.
company.description: Sublime Security is the adaptive, AI-powered cloud email security platform that combines effectiveness with visibility and control. The open platform allows security teams to have transparency and flexibility in their email environment to spend less time on email-originated incidents. Advanced teams can customize detections, threat hunt, extend Sublime into their SIEM or SOAR, and collaborate with other teams.
company.headquarters: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
